import collections
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    counts=collections.Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    others=[k for k in counts if k not in (2,3)]
    wall=min(others,key=lambda k:counts[k])
    two=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    three=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    s=min(two,key=lambda p:min(three,key=lambda q:abs(q[0]-p[0])+abs(q[1]-p[1])))
    t=min(three,key=lambda q:min(two,key=lambda p:abs(q[0]-p[0])+abs(q[1]-p[1])))
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    # BFS shortest clear path from s to t
    prev={}
    dq=collections.deque([s]); found=None
    while dq:
        c=dq.popleft()
        if c==t: break
        i,j=c
        for ni,nj in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)):
            if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and I[ni][nj]!=wall and (ni,nj) not in prev:
                prev[(ni,nj)]=c; dq.append((ni,nj))
    cur=t
    while True:
        out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
        if cur==s: break
        cur=prev[cur]
    return out
o=solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
exp=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(o==exp)
if o!=exp: print([(i,j,o[i][j],exp[i][j]) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]!=exp[i][j]])

def Lpath_info(I,s,t,wall,order):
    # order: 'Hv': row s from s.c to t.c, then col t from s.r to t.r; 'Vh' analog
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    if order=='Hv':
        seg1=(s[0],range(s[1]+1,t[1]),'r')
        seg2=(t[1],range(s[0]+1,t[0]),'c')
        clear1=all(I[s[0]][j]!=wall for j in range(s[1]+1,t[1]))
        clear2=all(I[i][t[1]]!=wall for i in range(s[0]+1,t[0]))
    else:
        seg1=(s[0],range(t[1]+1,s[1]),'r')
        seg2=(s[1],range(t[0]+1,s[0]),'c')
        clear1=all(I[s[0]][j]!=wall for j in range(t[1]+1,s[1]))
        clear2=all(I[i][s[1]]!=wall for i in range(t[0]+1,s[0]))
    return clear1 and clear2
def best_L(I,s,t,wall):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    opts=[]
    for ord_ in ('Hv','Vh'):

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
twos=[(i,j) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if I[i][j]==2]

    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen={s}; dq=deque([(s,0)])

        i,j=c
        for ni,nj in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)):

                seen.add((ni,nj)); dq.append(((ni,nj),d+1))

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda kk:cnt[kk])
    O=[list(r) for r in I]
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2]
    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==3]
    vA=len({c for _,c in twos})==1; hA=len({r for r,_ in twos})==1
    vB=len({c for _,c in threes})==1; hB=len({r for r,_ in threes})==1
    if vA and vB:
        ca={c for _,c in twos}.pop(); cb={c for _,c in threes}.pop()
        ra=max(r for r,_ in twos); rb=max(r for r,_ in threes)
        lo=max(ra,rb)+1
        cands=[]
        for r in range(lo,H):
            v1=all(I[i][ca]==bg for i in range(ra+1,r+1))
            v2=all(I[i][cb]==bg for i in range(rb+1,r+1))
            hrow=all(I[r][c]==bg for c in range(min(ca,cb),max(ca,cb)+1))
            if v1 and v2 and hrow: cands.append(r)
        conn=max(cands)
        for r in range(conn,ra,-1): O[r][ca]=3
        for r in range(conn,rb,-1): O[r][cb]=3
        for c in range(min(ca,cb),max(ca,cb)+1): O[conn][c]=3
        return O
    elif hA and hB:
        ra=min(r for r,_ in twos); rb=min(r for r,_ in threes)
        ca={c for _,c in twos}.pop(); cb={c for _,c in threes}.pop()
        lo=min(ca,cb)+1
        cands=[]
        for c in range(lo,W):
            hA=all(I[ra][x]==bg for x in range(ca+1,c+1))
            hB=all(I[rb][x]==bg for x in range(cb+1,c+1))
            vert=all(I[r][c]==bg for r in range(min(ra,rb)+1,max(ra,rb)))
            if hA and hB and vert: cands.append(c)
        conn=max(cands)
        for c in range(conn,ca,-1): O[ra][c]=3
        for c in range(conn,cb,-1): O[rb][c]=3
        for r in range(min(ra,rb),max(ra,rb)+1): O[r][conn]=3
        return O
    return None
for k in ['Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=lambda kk:cnt[kk])
# 7=noise(walls?), 8=passable. BFS from bar2 cells to bar3 cells through 8s only.
from collections import deque
start=[(4,c) for c in (12,13)]; goal=[(9,c) for c in (3,4)]
for wall_mode in [True,False]:
    dist={}
    q=deque()
    for s in start: dist[s]=0; q.append(s)
    found=None
    while q:
        cur=q.popleft()
        if cur in goal: found=cur; break
        r,c=cur
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n=(r+dr,c+dc)
            if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and n not in dist and (not wall_mode or I[n[0]][n[1]]==8):
                dist[n]=dist[cur]+1; q.append(n)
    print('wall mode',wall_mode,'reachable:',found is not None, 'pathlen', dist.get(found) if found else None)
    # reconstruct if reachable
    if found:
        path=[]
        cur=found
        while cur in dist and cur not in start:
            path.append(cur)
            r,c=cur
            prev=[n for n in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)] if n in dist and dist[n]==dist[cur]-1]
            cur=prev[0]
        path.reverse(); print('path:',path)

from collections import deque
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

def doms(I):
    d2={(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==2}
    d3={(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==3}
    return d2,d3
def candidates(I,A,B):
    H,W=I.shape; out=[]
    A=list(A); B=list(B)
    for mode in ['DV','RD']:
        if mode=='DV':  # down along A's col to below B, right to B's col
            ac=A[0][1]; bc=B[0][1]
            ar=max(r for r,c in A); br=max(r for r,c in B)
            for rr in range(ar+1,H):
                if bc<=ac: continue
                okv=all(I[r,ac]!=0 for r in range(ar+1,rr+1))
                okh=all(I[rr,c]!=0 for c in range(ac+1,bc+1))
                if okv and okh and rr>br:
                    cells=set([(r,ac) for r in range(ar+1,rr+1)]|set([(rr,c) for c in range(ac+1,bc+1)]))
                    out.append(('DV',cells))
        else:  # right along A's row to beside B, down to B's row
            ar=A[0][0]; br=B[0][0]
            al=max(c for r,c in A); bl=min(c for r,c in B)
            for cc in range(al+1,W):
                if bl>=cc: continue
                okh=all(I[ar,c]!=0 for c in range(al+1,cc+1))
                okv=all(I[r,cc]!=0 for r in range(ar+1,br+1))
                if okh and okv:
                    cells=set([(ar,c) for c in range(al+1,cc+1)]|set([(r,cc) for r in range(ar+1,br+1)]))
                    out.append(('RD',cells))
    return out
def solve(I,A,B,color):
    P=candidates(I,A,B)
    if not P: return I.copy()
    best=max(P,key=lambda p:len(p[1]))
    out=I.copy()
    for r,c in best[1]: out[r,c]=color
    return out

import os,re,numpy as np
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
I4=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 input']); O4=np.array(G['Demo pair 4 output'])
I5=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 input']); O5=np.array(G['Demo pair 5 output'])
T=np.array(G['Test input'])
def doms(I):
    return sorted([(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==2]), \
           sorted([(r,c) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==3])
def solve(I,A,B,color):
    H,W=I.shape; out=[]
    A,B=sorted(A),sorted(B)
    # DV: A vertical, down its col to below B's bottom, right to B's col (inclusive)
    ac=A[0][1]; ar=max(p[0] for p in A); br=max(p[0] for p in B); bc=B[0][1]
    for rr in range(ar+1,H):
        if not (all(I[r,ac]!=0 for r in range(ar+1,rr+1)) and all(I[rr,c]!=0 for c in range(ac,bc+1))): continue
        out.append(('DV',{(r,ac) for r in range(ar+1,rr+1)}|{(rr,c) for c in range(ac,bc+1)}))
    # RH-V: A horizontal, left along its row to just right of B, then down to B's row
    arow=A[0][0]; al=min(p[1] for p in A); bl=max(p[1] for p in B)
    for cc in range(bl+1,al):
        if not (all(I[arow,c]!=0 for c in range(cc,al)) and all(I[r,cc]!=0 for r in range(arow+1,B[0][0]))): continue
        out.append(('RHV', {(arow,c) for c in range(cc,al)}|{(r,cc) for r in range(arow+1,B[0][0])}))
    # RV-H: A horizontal, down its col? no: A horizontal, go... third orientation: A horizontal, down along A's column impossible. 
    # VH: A vertical but going UP? handle later.
    if not out: return I.copy()
    best=max(out,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))
    res=I.copy()
    for r,c in best[1]: res[r,c]=color
    return res

def solve(I,A,B,color):
    H,W=I.shape; out=[]
    A,B=sorted(A),sorted(B)
    for orient in ['vh','rh']:
        if orient=='vh':  # A vertical -> down its column, turn right to B
            ac=A[0][1]; ar=max(p[0] for p in A); bc=max(p[1] for p in B); br=max(p[0] for p in B)
            for rr in range(ar+1,H):
                segV=[(r,ac) for r in range(ar+1,rr+1)]
                segH=[(rr,c) for c in range(ac,bc+1)]
                bad=[p for p in (segV+segH) if I[p]!=0 and p not in A and p not in B]
                if len(bad)==0:
                    out.append((len(set(segV)|set(segH)), set(segV)|set(segH)))
        else:  # rh
            arow=A[0][0]; al=max(p[1] for p in A); bl=min(p[1] for p in B); br=max(p[0] for p in B)
            for cc in range(al+1,W):
                segR=[(arow,c) for c in range(al+1,cc+1)]
                segD=[(r,cc) for r in range(arow+1,br+1)]
                bad=[p for p in (segR+segD) if I[p]!=0 and p not in A and p not in B]
                if len(bad)==0:
                    out.append((len(set(segR)|set(segD)), set(segR)|set(segD)))
    if not out: return I.copy()
    best=max(out,key=lambda x:x[0])
    res=I.copy()
    for r,c in best[1]: res[r,c]=color
    return res

def solve(grid,A,B,color):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[]
    if len({r for r,_ in A})==2:  # A vertical -> down its col, turn right toward B's column, stop beside B
        ac=A[0][1]; ar=max(r for r,_ in A)
        bc=max(c for _,c in B)
        for rr in range(ar+1,H):
            segV=[(r,ac) for r in range(ar+1,rr+1)]
            segH=[(rr,c) for c in range(ac,bc+1)]
            cells=set(segV)|set(segH)
            ok=all(grid[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in A or (r,c) in B for r,c in cells)
            if ok: out.append(('vh',cells,len(cells)))
    if len({c for _,c in A})==2:  # A horizontal -> right along row, turn down to B's row
        arow=min(r for r,_ in A); al=max(c for _,c in A)
        bl=min(c for _,c in B)
        for cc in range(al+1,W):
            segR=[(arow,c) for c in range(al+1,cc+1)]
            segD=[(r,cc) for r in range(arow+1,max(r for r,_ in B)+1)]
